description: Zentrale KidMotion Bildwelt. Erst drei Cover, dann Nutzerwahl. Das gewählte Cover wird Szene 01 und Referenz. Google Flow erzeugt alle sichtbaren Texte; Remotion zeichnet nur den Countdown-Timer. Ab dieser Revision haben 5-Sekunden-Pausen eigene GET READY-Szenen und die 12 Übungen müssen klar unterschiedliche Silhouetten haben.
rules: 16:9 landscape, premium stylized 3D kids animation look
exactly one recurring KidMotion child per episode
same face, hair, age appearance, skin tone and body proportions throughout one episode
generate exactly three cover candidates first and STOP until the user explicitly chooses one
the selected cover is renamed Szene 01.png and becomes the primary character/outfit/world/color reference
all remaining final images are named Szene 02.png through Szene 28.png and stored in the same flat image folder
12 exercise scenes must have obviously different silhouettes, body levels and directions; avoid a sequence dominated by squat/lunge/balance variants
the same gym world may use different zones and modest camera-angle changes to avoid repetitive frames while keeping continuity
Szene 05 is the secondary exercise title/instruction UI reference for all later exercise scenes
dedicated GET READY scenes are Szene 06,08,10,12,14,16,18,20,22,24,26
every GET READY scene shows a neutral ready stance, not the next exercise pose, and contains GET READY plus NEXT: exercise title
ALL visible text except the changing countdown number is generated directly by Google Flow inside the source image
Szene 02 contains complete Intro text; Szene 03 Safety; Szene 04 LET'S BEGIN!
Szene 28 contains GREAT JOB! and WORKOUT COMPLETE
top-left 230x230 px remains clear on exercise and GET READY images for the Remotion timer
there is no Remotion progress bar and no Remotion REST/NEXT text
forbidden: generating Szene 02 or later before explicit user cover selection
cropped hands, feet or important joints
reusing the next 20-second exercise image during the 5-second transition
more than two neighboring exercises with near-identical squat/lunge/balance silhouettes
